summary: Scope bare mission start IDs to the mission path to prevent builder seat collisions

replay.detail: No replay or projection behavior changes.

schema.detail: No durable schema or field changes.

rules.detail: No authority or checkpoint rules change.

compatibility.detail: missions start --id DATE now creates mission-run/MISSION/DATE instead of mission-run/DATE. Explicit path IDs, including mission-run-prefixed paths, retain their existing meaning; generated default IDs are unchanged. Existing runs and seats are not renamed.

downtime.detail: No service interruption beyond normal deployment.

manual.detail: Scripts that address a newly started run by a bare ID must include the mission path in later commands or use the printed run subject. Use an explicit path to retain a custom full run ID.

recovery.detail: Existing run recovery and restart behavior are unchanged. The new naming prevents cross-mission collisions at start.
